name: FirstUK Bank Product and Service Overview

properties.question: What products and services does FirstUK Bank offer?
properties.answer_summary: FirstUK Bank offers a range of banking products and services for prospective customers
properties.customer_action: Visit www.firstuk.bank/faq for detailed information

properties.question: What is FirstUK Bank and where is it based? Is it regulated?
properties.answer_summary: FirstUK Bank is a UK retail bank headquartered in London with 12 branches across the UK. Regulated by the FCA and PRA.

properties.question: Is my money safe with FirstUK Bank?
properties.answer_summary: Deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to £85,000.

properties.question: How do I contact FirstUK Bank?
properties.answer_summary: Available via phone (0800-555-2265, Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–17:00), email (support@firstuk.bank), branch visit, or online chat at www.firstuk.bank during business hours.
properties.customer_action: Choose preferred contact method based on availability and urgency

properties.question: Does FirstUK Bank offer business banking?
properties.answer_summary: Currently, FirstUK Bank focuses on retail banking only. Business accounts are planned for 2027.

properties.clause_summary: Customer deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to £85,000 per depositor per institution.
properties.bank_obligations: Maintain FSCS membership and comply with FCA and PRA regulation

properties.question: What is the SmartSaver Account?
properties.answer_summary: Flagship savings account with competitive interest rates (4.50%–4.80%), no monthly fees, and easy access to money anytime

properties.question: What interest rate will I earn?
properties.answer_summary: Rates depend on balance: £0–£10,000 at 4.50% AER; £10,001–£50,000 at 4.70% AER; £50,001+ at 4.80% AER

properties.question: Is the interest rate fixed or variable?
properties.answer_summary: Variable rate that adjusts monthly with Bank of England base rate; fixed 2.5% margin maintained above BoE
properties.related_policy: variable rate adjustment with BoE + 2.5% margin

properties.question: When is interest paid?
properties.answer_summary: Monthly on the last business day of each month; interest calculated daily

properties.question: What are the fees?
properties.answer_summary: No monthly fees; optional fees include international ATM withdrawal (£2.50), international transfer (£5.00), and card replacement (£15.00)

properties.question: Can I withdraw my money anytime?
properties.answer_summary: Yes, anytime with no penalties or waiting periods; easy access is a core feature

properties.question: What's the minimum opening balance?
properties.answer_summary: Just £1; no minimum to open, no minimum to keep the account open

properties.question: Can I open a joint account?
properties.answer_summary: Yes; two customers can hold one SmartSaver Account together with equal withdrawal rights

properties.question: How do I open an account?
properties.answer_summary: Three channels: online (1–2 days), in branch (same day), or by post (5–7 days after requesting pack)
properties.customer_action: choose preferred channel and follow opening process

properties.question: What documents do I need?
properties.answer_summary: Photo ID (UK Passport or Driving License) and proof of address (utility bill, council tax, or bank statement)
properties.customer_action: provide required documentation during account opening

properties.feature_description: set up recurring payments to anyone
authorize billers to take payments automatically
arrange an overdraft limit

properties.rule_description: customer must be eligible to arrange an overdraft limit

properties.clause_summary: full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee for authorized payments

properties.question: What is the Current Account?
properties.answer_summary: checking account for everyday spending with no monthly fees, standing orders, and optional overdraft facility

properties.question: What are the fees?
properties.answer_summary: no monthly fee; overdraft interest at 15% AER if arranged overdraft is used

properties.question: Can I set up standing orders?
properties.answer_summary: yes, set up recurring payments to anyone, anytime
properties.customer_action: set up standing orders as needed

properties.question: Can I use Direct Debits?
properties.answer_summary: yes, authorize billers to take payments automatically with full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee

properties.question: Is there an overdraft?
properties.answer_summary: optional overdraft available; arrange limit of £500–£5,000 if eligible

properties.rule_description: borrower cannot exceed £500,000 loan amount for residential property
borrower must select a loan term between 2 and 25 years

properties.question: Does FirstUK Bank offer mortgages?
properties.answer_summary: Yes, FirstUK Bank offers residential mortgages with fixed rates (2 and 5-year terms) or variable rates

properties.question: What are current rates?
properties.answer_summary: Fixed 2-year: 4.50%–5.25% (depends on LTV); Fixed 5-year: 5.00%–5.75% (depends on LTV); Variable: BoE Base + 1.50%–2.25%

properties.question: How much can I borrow?
properties.answer_summary: Up to £500,000 for residential property

properties.question: How long is the loan term?
properties.answer_summary: 2–25 years (customer choice)

properties.question: What's the application process?
properties.answer_summary: Seven-step process: request information, submit application and documents, property valuation, underwriting review (5–10 days), offer issued, legal completion, funds released
properties.customer_action: initiate by requesting mortgage information and submitting application with required documents

properties.question: How long does the process take?
properties.answer_summary: Typically 4–6 weeks from application to completion

properties.question: Is online banking secure?
properties.answer_summary: Bank-level security with TLS 1.3 encryption, two-factor authentication, and 15-minute session timeout

properties.question: Do you have a mobile app?
properties.answer_summary: FirstUK Bank app available on Apple App Store and Google Play Store; requires iOS 13+ or Android 9+
properties.customer_action: Download FirstUK Bank from Apple App Store or Google Play Store

properties.question: Can I use biometric login?
properties.answer_summary: Mobile app supports fingerprint and face ID authentication for secure access

properties.question: Can I transfer money from home banking?
properties.answer_summary: Money transfers to other banks supported via online banking and mobile app; processing time 1–2 business days

properties.question: Is my data private?
properties.answer_summary: Full GDPR compliance; customer data is never shared with third parties for marketing purposes

properties.answer_summary: No hidden fees. All fees are clearly shown in the Pricing Guide.

properties.answer_summary: Fixed-rate mortgages incur 1–3% of outstanding balance; variable-rate mortgages have no early repayment fee.

properties.answer_summary: Fees may change with 30 days notice. Customers can close their account with no penalty if they disagree with changes.

properties.question: What if I'm unhappy with FirstUK Bank?
properties.answer_summary: Customers can contact FirstUK Bank via phone (0800-555-2265), email (support@firstuk.bank), or by visiting any branch location
properties.customer_action: Contact FirstUK Bank using one of the three available channels: phone, email, or branch visit

properties.question: What's the complaint process?
properties.answer_summary: Customer reports issue via phone/email/branch, bank investigates (typically 8 days), bank responds with decision and next steps, and if unresolved, customer can escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service at no cost
properties.customer_action: Report issue to FirstUK Bank; if unresolved after bank response, escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service

properties.question: How long does FirstUK take to respond?
properties.answer_summary: FirstUK Bank responds within 8 calendar days for standard complaints, or up to 8 weeks if the complaint is complex

properties.question: Can I complain to Financial Ombudsman?
properties.answer_summary: Yes, customers can escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service if unhappy with FirstUK Bank's response. The service is free and independent. Contact: Phone 0800 023 4567 or www.financialombudsman.org.uk
properties.customer_action: If dissatisfied with FirstUK Bank's response, contact Financial Ombudsman Service via phone or website

properties.question: What if my card is lost or stolen?
properties.answer_summary: Call 0800-555-2265 immediately to freeze the card. Replacement card arrives in 3–5 days, or overnight for £25 fee.
properties.customer_action: Call 0800-555-2265 immediately upon discovering card loss or theft

properties.question: What if I'm a victim of fraud?
properties.answer_summary: Report fraud immediately by calling 0800-555-FRAUD. The bank will investigate and refund unauthorized transactions within 10 days if confirmed as unauthorized.
properties.customer_action: Report fraud immediately by calling 0800-555-FRAUD

properties.question: How do I protect my account?
properties.answer_summary: Never share PIN or password, use safe ATMs only, monitor transactions regularly, report suspicious activity immediately, and use biometric login on mobile app.
customer_action: Use biometric login on mobile app
